title: VisaGenie
subtitle: An AI visa assistant built on LangChain, GPT-4, and Flask.

overview.label: 01 — Overview
overview.body: Visa applications are dense, procedural, and easy to get wrong. VisaGenie turns the process into a guided conversation — an AI assistant, built on LangChain and GPT-4, that asks the right question at the right step and gets applicants to a completed task instead of an abandoned form.

problem.label: 02 — The Problem
problem.quote: "A form doesn't know where you got stuck."
problem.body: Static visa forms and FAQ pages leave applicants to self-diagnose their own confusion. VisaGenie needed to hold context across a multi-step process and respond to wherever the applicant actually was — not a generic script.

process.name: Conversation Mapping
process.body: Delineate the decision tree behind the most common visa paths. Sketch / Paper

process.name: Prompt & Flow Design
process.body: Structured LangChain prompts to keep GPT-4 on track across multi-turn exchanges. System Diagram

process.name: Interface Design
process.body: Build a chat-first UI with clear progress and context affordances. Figma Design

process.name: Test & Iterate
process.body: Deliver prompts against friction points where users dropped off. User Testing

finalDesign.label: 05 — Final Design
cards: An applicant steps inside the guided conversation.
Progress and agency affordances on step UI.
Decision tree flow diagram behind the assistant.

outcomes.label: 06 — Outcomes
items: Task completion rate — applicants completing their visa application to end.
Replaced static forms with a guided, context-aware conversation.
Held context across a multi-step process instead of resetting at each screen.

reflection.label: 07 — Reflection
reflection.quote: The 95% conversion number mattered less than what it represented: a process that finally met people where their actual confusion was, instead of where a form assumed it would be.
